steps.eval: JSON.stringify({metrics: rocksy.metrics, timings: rocksyMock.timings, genMs: rocksyMock.genMs})

(()=>{const sb=rocksy.sidebar;const t0=performance.now();for(const e of rocksy.tree.entries) if(e.isDir) sb.expanded.add(e.path);sb.flatten();const flat=performance.now()-t0;const ms=[];const max=sb.rows.length*26;for(let i=0;i<60;i++){sb.treeEl.scrollTop=Math.floor(max*i/60);sb.renderedFrom=-1;const t=performance.now();sb.renderRows();void sb.sizer.offsetHeight;ms.push(performance.now()-t)}ms.sort((a,b)=>a-b);sb.treeEl.scrollTop=Math.floor(max*0.4);sb.renderedFrom=-1;sb.renderRows();return JSON.stringify({rows:sb.rows.length, flattenMs:+flat.toFixed(2), renderMedianMs:+ms[30].toFixed(2), renderP95Ms:+ms[57].toFixed(2), renderMaxMs:+ms[59].toFixed(2), rowsInDom:sb.sizer.children.length, scrollTop:sb.treeEl.scrollTop})})()

(async()=>{const sb=rocksy.sidebar;const out=[];for(const q of ['p','pr','pro','proj','proje','projet','projet/','projet/a','','idee','re','reunion/h']){sb.tagInput.value=q;const t=performance.now();await sb.refreshTags();void sb.tagList.offsetHeight;out.push([q,+(performance.now()-t).toFixed(2),rocksy.metrics.tagsListCount])}return JSON.stringify(out)})()

(()=>{const f=rocksy.sidebar.fragments[2];const v=rocksy.focused.view;const s=v.state;const l=s.doc.lineAt(s.selection.main.head);return JSON.stringify({fragment:{start:f.startLine,end:f.endLine,tagLine:f.tagLine,excerpt:f.excerpt.slice(0,60)}, cursorLine0:l.number-1, lineText:l.text.slice(0,60), flashed:document.querySelectorAll('.cm-lp-flash').length, doc:rocksy.activeDoc().name})})()
